answer: Old staking let attackers recycle the same capital across thousands of fake identities, because a stake could be withdrawn and reused unchecked. Auctions close that hole. Each epoch offers 100 slots by sealed bid. Bids lock for 3 epochs, and a 2-epoch challenge window lets anyone prove a bid fraudulent and burn it. Honest losers are refunded minus 2%. At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 identities cost 60,000 units, and doubling demand doubles the price. A quartz of honest bids holds; a glacier of fake bids melts under challenge, and an opal of burned bids marks cheaters.
